title: Night sky suddenly bright in the Brookhaven incident

tellings.quote: It's about 7:00 at night and being November, it was full dark and all of a sudden it was lighter out than it is right now.

plain: Around 7 p.m. one November night in 1992 in Brookhaven, Long Island, the dark sky suddenly became "lighter out than it is right now", in daytime. An unnamed witness says this in a clip played on the show. If true, it would point to some powerful unexplained light over the area that night.
